race.comment: Looks another lovely race for the progressive DARKBONEE (10) who flew home fresh with a big weight then won well here last time over 1600m, coming from off the speed to score by 1.75 lengths. He looks to be one trying to sneak into a Caulfield Cup so they'll need to win this and he gets the right run to do so. SAINT GEORGE (2) did beat DARKBONEE when they met last preparation on a similar weight scale. SAINT GEORGE won impressively at Flemington last start but is off a let up here. Not discounting. SHOCKLETZ (14) ran on well off a short break at Flemington over 1620m. Much better suited this trip but the draw isn't ideal. SEE THAT STORM (9) found form with a good win over STAR OF INDIA (4) at Flemington. SEE THAT STORM would want it as dry as possible, STAR OF INDIA probably does as well and both draw awkwardly.
